transcript.text: Thanks for calling Lakeside Family Clinic, this is Robin. How can I help?
Hi. I need a refill on my blood pressure medication.
I can help you with scheduling an appointment for that. May I have your full name, please?
Can you just send it to the pharmacy?
I’m sorry, but I can’t send prescriptions directly. You’ll need to see the doctor for a refill. When would you like to come in for an appointment?
Okay. And can you tell me what my cholesterol results were?
I don’t have access to test results, but your doctor can go over them with you during your visit. When would you like to schedule your appointment?
You’re welcome! If you change your mind or need anything else, just give us a call. Have a great day!
